scope: First actual Qwen3-4B-Base adapter updates on historical 6E causal snapshots. A bounded engineering trial, not a full epoch, validated trading strategy or EURUSD CFD execution model.

training.selection: Twenty evenly spaced rank indices fixed from train example count before inspecting labels; no replacement, label-based selection or reweighting

resources.note: Memory headroom remains tight. This result does not certify larger batches, longer sequences or full training capacity. The worker boundary is a deadline, not an OS sandbox or hard VRAM quota.

evaluation_reservation.note: Whole calendar periods reserved from pinned project inventory and metadata only. No profit/quality subset was selected. No-replay-documented is not proof of absence of external inspection or a certification of event-level quality.

verification.skip_reason: Optional native Nautilus evaluation dependency not installed

limitations: Twenty distinct single-example updates are only about 0.102 percent of the supervised training set. No full epoch was run.
Losses and the training-record reload probe are optimizer/persistence diagnostics, not forecast accuracy, financial performance or evidence that feature relationships were learned.
All 2025 roles were previously exposed development. Later development roles are not untouched validation/test evidence; none entered this fit.
Targets are fifteen-second crossed-quote futures proxies at three extra cost settings, not EURUSD CFD fills, broker costs or an executable trading policy.
Inputs are sampled current causal snapshots, not all raw event sequences. Supervision excludes uncertain future observability and is strongly imbalanced.
No prediction evaluation or trading occurred. The saved adapter is not installed into any trading or inference runner.
next: Freeze the candidate and a bounded evaluation protocol before any prediction/outcome scoring. Establish strict structured-output checks, fixed no-opportunity/prior controls, per-class precision/recall and prediction coverage.
Use already-exposed later development only for clearly labeled diagnostics. Keep the separate 2026 test and lockbox reservations unopened during development and tuning.

After diagnostics, preregister a larger train-only experiment and its resource limits. Independent cost-aware evidence and broker-specific paper validation are still required before any adapter promotion.
